params.name: merchantGuid
params.description: Unique identifier assigned to the client by ConnexPay.

params.name: postDateFrom
params.description: Starting ticket issued date for the transactions to retrieve. Either postDateFrom and postDateTo or settledDateFrom and settledDateTo are required.

params.name: postDateTo
params.description: Ending ticket issued date for the transactions to retrieve. Either postDateFrom and postDateTo or settledDateFrom and settledDateTo are required.

params.name: settledDateFrom
params.description: Starting settlement timestamp for the transactions to retrieve. Either postDateFrom and postDateTo or settledDateFrom and settledDateTo are required.

params.name: settledDateTo
params.description: Ending settlement timestamp for the transactions to retrieve. Either postDateFrom and postDateTo or settledDateFrom and settledDateTo are required.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The page number for the transactions to retrieve in this call.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of transactions to retrieve in this call.

items.docs: Either postDateFrom and postDateTo OR settledDateFrom and settledDateTo must be provided. (Note: Records will only be returned by the postDateFrom/To range if the transaction has settled.) For Authentication with this API, you must first obtain a token through https://docs.connexpay.com/reference/reporting-token. This endpoint is only accessible in Production.
